reviewed_scope: Static review of the checked-out tree, git metadata, Go module graph, GitHub Actions workflows, Nix files, and committed image assets. No runtime execution.

expected_network.data: preset start/stop/toggle commands; JSON status response
expected_network.notes: Plain HTTP/1.1, any method accepted, no Origin/Host validation. Local-only attack surface, but any local process or a browser page can trigger state changes (CSRF/DNS-rebinding style).

expected_network.enabled_by: go build -tags pprof (not part of default build)
expected_network.data: net/http/pprof runtime profiles and goroutine dumps
expected_network.notes: Development-only build tag. Exposes sensitive process internals; never ship a release with this tag.
Host is hard-coded to localhost; only the port is configurable per preset. No arbitrary payload or exfiltration path in app code.

expected_exec.notes: Opens the per-preset temp log file with the OS default handler.
Opens the config folder with the OS file manager.
Shared helper used for the configured kanata executable and for config-defined hooks. Arbitrary local code execution is a documented feature, not a network path.

expected_non_ip_ipc.mechanism: GTK3 / libayatana-appindicator over D-Bus and the display server socket
expected_non_ip_ipc.notes: GUI library; no socket()/connect()/HTTP in the imported package. The example/ and webview_example/ directories are separate binaries and are not imported.

expected_non_ip_ipc.mechanism: Cocoa/AppKit event loop (Mach ports, window server)

expected_build_time_network.trigger: go build / go run / nix build with a cold module cache
expected_build_time_network.notes: Integrity is enforced by go.sum. Check for a replace directive or a changed go.sum before trusting a build.
flake.lock pins narHash + rev. The flake input ref is nixpkgs-unstable but the lock is the effective pin.

expected_build_time_network.endpoint: GitHub Actions marketplace, GitHub API, cachix.org
expected_build_time_network.notes: Actions are tag-pinned, not SHA-pinned. Release job can publish artifacts. No pull_request_target workflow. Cachix token is only used on push to main.

notes: Baseline is a point-in-time snapshot, not a trust anchor. Re-derive it only after reviewing a diff.
Any new network import, remote host, exec sink, CI action, or binary asset is a review event.
The control server and pprof listeners are inbound-only and loopback-bound; they are not exfiltration paths.
The app has no outbound HTTP client, DNS resolver, UDP, TLS, SMTP, SSH, WebSocket, gRPC, or auto-update code.
